# NatalProfile

> Personal astrology and numerology PDF reports made by a Telegram bot from birth data.

- Site: https://natalprofile.com/
- Bot: https://t.me/natalprofile_bot
- Languages published: en, ru, es, hi, pt, vi, tr, id, uz, kk, fr, de, it, ar, fa
- Reports: Natal Chart (Full Analysis), Natal Chart (Basic Analysis), Compatibility Analysis (Full Review), Compatibility Analysis (Basic Review), Career and Financial Analysis, Child's Chart — A guide to your child, Yearly Forecast (Solar Return), Daily Horoscope, Numerology by Name and Birth Date, Vedic Chart (Jyotish)
- Payment: Telegram Stars, per report, no subscription.
- The site itself collects no data; its two calculators run in the browser.
- Reports are for self-reflection and entertainment; not medical, financial or legal advice.
- This static site sets a Content-Security-Policy via a meta tag only (GitHub Pages sends no custom security headers).
